title: Public jurisdiction index and dossiers merge ISO-3166 country codes with USPS state codes: 'DE' = 24 Cologne (Germany) cameras, 'ID' = 232 Idaho + 268 Indonesia sites, 'MN' = Minnesota + a Mongolian registry
evidence: GET /dossier/de/ (sha256 8c1fe613…) -> '24 of 24 evaluable geolocated site observations in DE', sources camreg_mueller_de only; /dossier/id/ (a66118fb…) -> 498 of 500, sources camreg_achd_id + camreg_indonesia_id; /dossier/mn/ (b0375753…) -> camreg_carver_mn, camreg_mndot_mn, camreg_monmap_mn. Public sites CSVs: camreg_mueller_de points at ~(6.96E, 50.95N) Cologne, camreg_indonesia_id 268 points in Java. camera_registry_targets.toml:1399-1405 (mueller_de state='DE', jurisdiction_scheme='iso.3166_1_alpha2'), :1479-1488 (monmap_mn 'MN' iso), :1991 (indonesia_id); connectors/src/connectors/dot_511.py:639 emits candidate={scheme,value} but jurisdictions.csv/dossier_index.json key on the bare code (55 keys mixing AL..WY with AU-ACT, DE, ID, MN, SA, TH). Registry rows carry these state values unchecked against coordinates.

title: The national ALPR layer (~151,700 of 154,528 OSM-derived sites) is ingested from two overlapping third-party ArcGIS republishes of DeFlock/OSM data (not the OSM origin), registered as a 'government_portal' source; osm_overpass, the origin connector, is bounded to the OKC bbox
evidence: targets: osm_surveillance_deflock (ArcGIS item d6267b54… 'ALPR Camera Locations (Deflock)', 132,689 rows) + osm_surveillance_alpr_nationwide (item e7cc29c2…, Stanford personal account, 19,044 rows) + 4 small CCTV republishes; sources.toml camreg_osm_surveillance source_kind='government_portal', custody MIRROR; live_targets.toml osm_overpass bbox (35.30,-97.85,35.75,-97.15). Two republishes of the same OSM origin are not independent (P15; acquisition_queue.toml invariant on lineage_class). Freshness depends on republisher cadence; osm_physical/sites.csv 154,528 rows camreg_osm_surveillance vs 177 camreg_rochester_ny.
